observations: GTIN 3574661800202 is corroborated by dm, Rossmann, and Mueller with only formatting differences.
Sodium Methyl Cocoyl Taurate, Decyl Glucoside, and Cocamidopropyl Betaine form the cleanser base.
Hydrolyzed Collagen, modified potato starch, cationic starch, Amodimethicone, and Glyceryl Oleate form the bodying/deposition architecture.
